campaign: Model facts as typed OvergoDB runtime authority
doctrine: Classify literals by semantics and provenance, never numeric magnitude. Structural identities such as zero checks and unit indexing remain local. Mathematical and storage-format constants stay with neutral operators. Capacity hints derive from compiled ownership when available. Any value that changes with model, processor, tokenizer, checkpoint, or training profile must come from artifact metadata or a typed profile published in OvergoDB and bound by the active recipe. Derived values are formulas over resolved facts, not redundant stored fields. Runtime entry points hard-fail on missing facts. No family fallback, default constructor, compatibility wrapper, property bag, or advisory plan may remain after callers migrate. Each wave moves every caller and deletes displaced code in the same commit.

items.title: Make active flow profiles own binding and embedding facts

steps.title: Resolve tensor prefixes and sinusoidal period from the active profile and delete SenseNovaFlowBinding
steps.rationale: The period 10000 is external model evidence, not universal math. Recipe-bound profile data must reach host and CUDA flow plans identically.

items.title: Make OvergoDB own scratch construction policy

steps.title: Resolve the active derivation profile and delete direct AdaptiveDerivationProfile runtime callers
steps.rationale: Corpus split, topology minima, MLP budget, epsilon, and optimizer policy are versioned construction policy. Retain bootstrap data only as publication input, then remove runtime default access.

items.title: Derive implementation capacities and positional bindings from compiled programs

steps.title: Replace diffusion graph capacity and positional tensor indices with compiled counts and typed bindings
steps.rationale: The map capacity 256 is an implementation hint, not a model fact. Positional indices 5 through 17 encode unnamed structure. Compile both from validated inventory declarations without moving them into OvergoDB model facts.

steps.title: Publish semantic census evidence and reject uncatalogued model facts or stale bindings
steps.rationale: Acceptance requires active typed profiles for each migrated runtime, no family fallback path, zero test policy copies, and host/CUDA parity through the same compiled facts.
